view_naming: The validator's raw view is this inventory's physical view; the effective view is the layered mount the running game sees.
denominator_policy: Every enumerated TED record, including acquisition and parser failures, is included in its selected VFS-view denominator. Every persisted-object record and every declared reference stays in its resolution denominator whether or not it resolves; no row is dropped to improve a rate.
semantic_completion_policy: A structurally retained raw-only TED is not counted as a semantic map.
resolution_policy: Placement type CRCs resolve against the profile's active XML catalog winners. A uniquely typed placement's model chain is the resolved effective object's Land_Model_Name (land), Space_Model_Name (space) or Model_Name, probed against the effective VFS under data/art/models/ with .alo suffix substitution. Terrain-material, water-surface (1/257/0 minis 0x1D/0x1E) and cloud textures probe data/art/textures/ with .tga/.dds stem substitution. Environment skydome fields name XML objects, so they resolve against the catalog and their own model chain is reported separately. References are probed against the effective mount in both views, because the question is whether the running game would find the asset.
catalog_gate: These rates are measured against the currently loadable XML catalog. P0-05 (#5) is not accepted, so they are evidence for #26 and do not by themselves close its catalog-acceptance gate.
provenance: Generated inventories contain logical paths, source IDs, hashes, and aggregate counts only; no install roots or file bytes.

effective_aggregate.scope: sum of the three effective profile views; a logical map present in multiple profiles counts once in each profile view

acceptance_denominator: Per the clean TED contract, the effective VFS view is the acceptance denominator for the 99 percent placement-type target. The physical view is provenance only: shadowed duplicates are reported, never counted toward or against acceptance.
map_issue_policy: map_issues lists each typed TED notice (MapIssue) with the maps that carry it and its total occurrences. Only framing errors fail a load; a failed semantic view is a notice with the raw chunk tree retained.
